item.coloph: zhes gshen rab rnam par rgyal ba'i me mchod 'dod gsol ring mo tshig bzhi tshigs su bcad pa 'di ni/ dpal ldan lhun grub sgang du skyabs kyi ston pa rin chen 'od zer gyis rnam rgyal mdo gzungs chen mo la/ bka' brten du btus nas 'gro don sbyar bas dge legs 'phel 'gyur cig/
